title: Credits
lead: Utago is built with the help of the open data and open-source software below.
jmdictDesc: We use part of the JMdict dictionary data from the EDRDG (Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group) to fill in word meanings. Korean meanings were created from this data.
kuromojiDesc: We use the open-source morphological analyzer Kuromoji (Atilika, Apache License 2.0) to generate furigana and extract words from lyrics.
audioDesc: Music is played through the YouTube player.
